name: Животноводство

pages.text: $(thing)Домашний скот$() — это животные, которых можно приручивать и разводить. Домашняя скотина может быть $(thing)самцом$() или $(thing)самкой$(). У некоторых животных можно визуально определить пол. Например, у самцов свиней есть клыки.

Домашний скот $(thing)стареет$(). Они рождаются маленькими и по началу не могут давать полезные ресурсы. После определенного количества дней они вырастают во $(thing)взрослых$() животных, которые могут размножаться или производить молоко. После того как они размножились или были использованы для получения продуктов животноводства достаточное количество раз, животные становятся $(thing)старыми$(), и полезны только своим мясом.
Этот бык стар и не может размножаться, поэтому у него блеклая шерсть и серые глаза.

Домашний скот можно кормить, чтобы повысить $(thing)привязанность$(). У каждого животного есть предпочтительная еда. Чтобы покормить животное, нажмите $(item)$(k:key.sneak)$() и $(item)$(k:key.use)$() с едой в руке по животному.
У домашнего скота есть индикатор-сердечко, показывающий уровень $(thing)привязанности$() к вам. Зажмите $(item)$(k:key.sneak)$(), чтобы увидеть его.
Привязанность уменьшается ежедневно, если животное не кормить. Небольшое повышение привязанности (белый контур сердечка) предотвращает её снижение.
Взрослый домашний скот не может быть полностью приручен (красный контур сердечка). А вот родившееся у них потомство может быть приручено.

$(thing)Млекопитающие$() — это домашний скот, который может $(thing)беременнеть$(). Взрослые млекопитающие, привязанность которых выше 30 % и которые были накормлены в этот день, будут спариваться, если они противоположного пола и находятся рядом друг с другом. Самка становится $(thing)беременной$(), что приводит к рождению потомства через определенное количество дней после оплодотворения.$(br)Пример — $(l:mechanics/animal_husbandry#pig)свиньи$().

$(thing)Wooly Animals$() are $(l:food/animal_husbandry#mammals)Mammals$() that can be $(thing)Sheared$() if they are adults and familiar enough to you. Some examples are $(l:food/animal_husbandry#sheep)Sheep$(), $(l:food/animal_husbandry#alpaca)Alpacas$(), and $(l:food/animal_husbandry#musk_ox)Musk Oxen$().
Ножницы можно сделать путём $(l:mechanics/anvils#welding)сварки$() двух $(thing)лезвий ножа$() вместе. Лезвие ножа с наименьшим бонусом ковки (если он имеется) передаст этот бонус ножницам.

$(thing)Dairy Animals$() are mammals that make $(thing)Milk$(). Female dairy animals can be clicked with a bucket to obtain milk. Some examples are $(l:food/animal_husbandry#goat)Goats$(), $(l:food/animal_husbandry#cow)Cows$(), and $(l:food/animal_husbandry#yak)Yaks$().

pages.title: Насест
pages.text: $(thing)Oviparous Animals$() are not $(l:food/animal_husbandry#mammals)Mammals$(), and instead produce children by laying $(thing)Eggs$(). They need a $(thing)Nest Box$() to lay eggs, which they are capable of locating on their own.$(br)Some examples are $(l:food/animal_husbandry#duck)Ducks$(), $(l:food/animal_husbandry#quail)Quails$(), and $(l:food/animal_husbandry#chicken)Chickens$().

$(thing)Яйца$() можно сварить или пожарить для употребления в пищу. Самцы яйцекладущих животных могут оплодотворять самок, которые в свою очередь отложат оплодотворённые яйца. Такие яйца будут иметь подсказку с указанием времени до вылупления птенца.

$(thing)Однокопытные$() — это $(l:mechanics/animal_husbandry#mammals)млекопитающие$(), которых можно оседлать после приручения. Они пригодны для верховой езды при достижении 15% привязанности. Лошади передают свои $(thing)генетические характеристики$(), включая скорость, высоту прыжка, здоровье, размер и отметины. Потомок скрещивания лошади и осла — это $(thing)мул$().
Седла можно вырезать из кожи.

They need a $(thing)Saddle$() to ride, which can be $(thing)Knapped$(). This includes $(l:food/animal_husbandry#mule)Mules$(), $(l:food/animal_husbandry#donkey)Donkeys$(), and $(l:food/animal_husbandry#horses)Horses$(). Mules and Donkeys can hold any chest or barrel. If holding a barrel, $(item)$(k:key.use)$() while holding $(item)$(k:key.sneak)$() can be used to remove it. The same keys while holding a bucket can be used to drain fluid from the barrel. $(br2)The next few pages will go over all livestock types.

$(thing)Pigs$() spawn in mild forests with $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() between -10 and 35°C, and at least 200mm of $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$(). They are $(l:food/animal_husbandry#mammals)Mammals$() with no special abilities. They will eat any food, even if it is rotten. They have 1-10 children, are pregnant for just 19 days, and reach adulthood in 80 days. They can have children 6 times.
pages.title: Свиньи

pages.text: Свинья.

$(thing)Rabbits$() spawn in $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperatures$() above -16°C, and at least 15mm of $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$(), changing their coat based on climate. They are $(l:food/animal_husbandry#mammals)Mammals$() with no special abilities, aside from being known for chewing on carrots and cabbage. They will eat any food, even if it is rotten. They have 1-6 children, are pregnant for just 19 days, and reach adulthood in 20 days. They can have children 6 times.
pages.title: Кролики

pages.text: Кролик.

$(thing)Cows$() spawn in most climates, between $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() -10 and 35°C, and at least 250mm of $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$(). They are $(l:food/animal_husbandry#dairy_animals)Dairy Animals$(). They only eat $(thing)grains$(), which may be rotten. They can have 1-2 children, are pregnant for 58 days, and reach adulthood in 192 days. They can have children 13 times, if they are never milked, or be milked 128 times, if they are never bred. They produce milk every day.
pages.title: Коровы

pages.text: Корова.

$(thing)Goats$() spawn in moderate climates, with $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() between -12 and 25°C, and at least 300mm of $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$(). They are $(l:food/animal_husbandry#dairy_animals)Dairy Animals$(). They eat $(thing)grains$(), $(thing)fruits$(), and $(thing)vegetables$(), which may be rotten. They can have 1-2 children, are pregnant for 32 days, and reach adulthood in 96 days. They can have children 6 times if they are never milked, or be milked 60 times if they are never bred. They produce milk every 3 days.
pages.title: Козы

pages.text: Коза.

$(thing)Yaks$() spawn in cold climates, with $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() of at most -11°C, and at least 100mm of $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$(). They are $(l:food/animal_husbandry#dairy_animals)Dairy Animals$(). They eat only fresh $(thing)grains$(). They always have 1 child, are pregnant for 64 days, and reach adulthood in 180 days. They can have children 23 times, if they are never milked, or be milked 230 times, if they are never bred. They produce milk once a day.
pages.title: Як

pages.text: Як.

$(thing)Alpacas$() spawn in moderate climates, with $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() between -8 and 20°C, and at least 250mm of $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$(). They are $(l:food/animal_husbandry#wooly_animals)Wooly Animals$(). They eat $(thing)grains$() and $(thing)fruits$(). They have 1-2 children, are pregnant for 36 days, and reach adulthood in 98 days. They can have children 13 times, if they are never sheared, or be sheared 128 times, if they are never bred. They grow wool every 4 days.
pages.title: Альпака

pages.text: Альпака.

$(thing)Sheep$() spawn in drier climates, with $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() between 0 and 35°C, and between 70 and 300mm of $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$(). They are $(l:food/animal_husbandry#wooly_animals)Wooly Animals$(). They eat $(thing)grains$(). They have 1-2 children, are pregnant for 32 days, and reach adulthood in 56 days. They can have children 6 times, if they are never sheared, or be sheared 60 times, if they are never bred. They grow wool every 3 days.
pages.title: Овцы

pages.text: Овца.

$(thing)Musk Oxen$() spawn in cold climates, with $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() between -25 and 0°C, and at least 100mm of $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$(). They are $(l:food/animal_husbandry#wooly_animals)Wooly Animals$(). They eat $(thing)grains$(). They always have 1 child, are pregnant for 64 days, and reach adulthood in 168 days. They can have children 16 times, if they are never sheared, or be sheared 160 times if they are never bred. They grow wool every 3 days.
pages.title: Овцебыки

pages.text: Овцебык.

$(thing)Bactrian Camels$() spawn in cold deserts, with $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() of at most -5°C, and at most 100mm of $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$(). They are $(l:food/animal_husbandry#wooly_animals)Wooly Animals$() and can be ridden. They are slower than horses, but faster on sand and snow. They eat $(thing)grains$() and $(thing)fruits$(). They have 1 child, are pregnant for 24 days, and become adults in 80 days. They can have children 8 times if they are never sheared, or be sheared 80 times if they are never bred. They grow wool every 7 days.
pages.title: Bactrian Camel

pages.text: A bactrian camel.

$(thing)Chickens$() spawn in warm forests, with $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() of at least 14°C, and at least 225mm of $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$(). They are $(l:food/animal_husbandry#oviparous_animals)Oviparous Animals$(). They eat $(thing)grains$(), $(thing)fruits$(), $(thing)vegetables$(), and $(thing)seeds$(), which can be rotten. Their eggs hatch in 8 days, and become adults in 24 days. They can lay eggs 100 times. They produce eggs every 30 hours.
pages.title: Куры

pages.text: Курица.

$(thing)Ducks$() spawn in most plains, with $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() between -25 and 30°C, and at least 100mm of $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$(). They are $(l:food/animal_husbandry#oviparous_animals)Oviparous Animals$(). They eat $(thing)grains$(), $(thing)fruits$(), $(thing)vegetables$(), $(thing)bread$(), and $(thing)seeds$(). Their eggs hatch in 8 days, and become adults in 32 days. They can lay eggs 72 times. They produce eggs every 32 hours.
pages.title: Утки

pages.text: Утка.

$(thing)Quails$() spawn in colder climates, with $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() between -15 and 15°C, and at least 200mm of  $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$(). They are $(l:food/animal_husbandry#oviparous_animals)Oviparous Animals$(). They eat $(thing)grains$(), $(thing)fruits$(), $(thing)vegetables$(), and $(thing)seeds$(), which can be rotten. Their eggs hatch in 8 days, and become adults in 22 days. They can lay eggs 48 times. They produce eggs every 28 hours.
pages.title: Перепел

pages.text: Перепел.

$(thing)Donkeys$() spawn in wetter plains, with $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() of at least -15°C, and between 130 and 400mm of $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$(). They are a kind of $(l:food/animal_husbandry#horses)Equine$() that can carry a $(thing)chest$(). They eat $(thing)grains$() and $(thing)fruits$(). They have 1 child, are pregnant for 19 days, and reach adulthood in 80 days. They can have children 6 times.
pages.title: Ослы

pages.text: Осел.

$(thing)Mules$() spawn in plains with $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() of at least -15°C, and between 130 and 400mm of $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$(). They are a kind of $(l:food/animal_husbandry#horses)Equine$() that can carry a $(thing)chest$() and are the sterile product of a $(thing)horse$() and a $()donkey$(). They eat $(thing)grains$() and $(thing)fruits$(). They reach adulthood in 80 days.
pages.title: Мулы

pages.text: Мул.

$(thing)Horses$() spawn in plains with $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() of at least -15°C, and between 130 and 400mm of $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$(). They are a kind of $(l:food/animal_husbandry#horses)Equine$(). They eat $(thing)grains$() and $(thing)fruits$(). They have 1 child, are pregnant for 19 days, and reach adulthood in 80 days. They can have children 6 times.
pages.title: Лошади

pages.text: Лошадь.

$(thing)Dromedary Camels$() spawn in drier climates, with $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperature$() of at least -5°C, and at most 100mm of $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$(). They are $(l:food/animal_husbandry#mammals)Mammals$() that can be ridden. They are slower than horses, but are immune to cacti and run fast on sand. They eat $(thing)grains$() and $(thing)fruits$(). They have 1 child, are pregnant for 19 days, and reach adulthood in 80 days. They can have children 6 times.
pages.title: Dromedary Camels

pages.text: A dromedary camel.

$(thing)Frogs$() spawn in $(l:core_mechanics/climate#temperature)temperatures$() above -13°C, and at least 150mm of $(l:core_mechanics/climate#rainfall)rainfall$(). They can be familiarized, and when bred they will lay eggs in fresh water, which hatch into tadpoles. They will eat fish and spider eyes.

pages.text: Лягушка.
